What kind of material is used to make the cutleries?
format:[material]
thinking: The user wants the material of the cutleries (fork, spoon, knife) visible in the image. Looking at the table, the utensils are black, with a glossy sheen and a molded, uniform appearance typical of disposable tableware. They are not metallic (no silver/steel shine) nor ceramic. The black color and slight translucency/gloss suggest plastic. The format requires just the material name. So the answer is "plastic".
